name: POST /attachments/v2/ (CDN) — файл > 2МБ → 200/201
description:
Проверки нового CDN endpoint загрузки файлов.
    dev:  https://dev-upload.myqrcards.com/attachments/v2/
    prod: https://upload.myqrcards.com/attachments/v2/
descriptionHtml:
Проверки нового CDN endpoint загрузки файлов.
dev:  https://dev-upload.myqrcards.com/attachments/v2/
prod: https://upload.myqrcards.com/attachments/v2/
statusMessage:
AssertionError: CDN large upload failed: 401 [{"traceIdentifier":"0HNO1NRKM4HN3:0000000B","code":"InvalidToken","message":"Некорректный или недействительный токен."}]
assert 401 in (<HTTPStatus.OK: 200>, <HTTPStatus.CREATED: 201>)
 +  where 401 = <Response [401]>.status_code
